105:t_1:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...So you and the others were investigating $$ネオ・ジオン$$ independently, $$刹那$$.」

105:t_1:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm sorry. We still don't know Colonel $$シャア$$'s whereabouts.」

105:t_1:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「He's doing his own thing. We don't need to worry about him.」

105:t_1:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But on the other hand, the fact that we can't contact $$シャア$$ probably shows just how powerful $$ネオ・ジオン$$ under $$フル・フロンタル$$ has become.」

105:t_1:8.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That's right. If the $$地球連邦$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ fought head-on now, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ would undoubtedly win.」

105:t_1:9.en:
$$エマ$$
「The Federation and $$ジオン$$... The Federation had greater national strength in their previous wars, but now even that has been reversed.」

105:t_1:10.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Still, space is their home ground. They probably won't invade Earth with their entire army.」

105:t_1:11.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「That's right. If they did, they'd clash with the $$新地球皇国$$ too.」

105:t_1:14.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「...Did I... say something strange?」

105:t_1:15.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「It's not your fault, $$ハサウェイ$$.」

105:t_1:16.en:
$$マリー$$
「But something you can't imagine... No, something you don't want to imagine, may be happening.」

105:t_1:18.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「They could. $$ネオ・ジオン$$ may be in league with $$サイデリアル$$.」

105:t_1:20.en:
$$ファ$$
「They can't... $$スペースノイド$$s are people of Earth just like us...」

105:t_1:21.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It's true he... $$フル・フロンタル$$ said he'd obey $$ジェミニス$$ after dropping $$アクシズ$$, but...!」

105:t_1:22.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But...! But if they do that, won't the fighting only spread!?」

105:t_1:25.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Right now, it's only a possibility. Everything will become clear here in North America.」

105:t_1:26.en:
$$刹那$$
「This is where the $$地球連邦$$ and $$新地球皇国$$ are fighting on equal terms... Now that $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has resumed operations, it will probably intervene here.」

105:t_1:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This continent's $$レイライン$$s also converge at the $$ターミナル・ベース$$s governing each region, then are gathered at the core, the $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

105:t_1:28.en:
$$カツ$$
「So our objective is to attack that $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

105:t_1:29.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We've resupplied with goods from $$ソレスタルビーイング$$. Now all we have to do is move forward.」

105:t_1:30.en:
$$イアン$$
「Sorry, Captain. Since you've been having a rough time, I wanted to get you a slightly better mobile suit, but...」

105:t_1:31.en:
$$イアン$$
「Things have been chaotic everywhere, and I couldn't even follow up on my contacts.」

105:t_1:32.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't worry about it, $$イアン$$. The $$リ・ガズィ$$ isn't a bad machine.」

105:t_1:33.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$刹那$$ is fighting in the $$ダブルオーライザー$$ too. I can't afford to be picky either.」

105:t_1:34.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Remember this, $$ハサウェイ$$. This is what they mean when they say differences in mobile suit performance aren't the decisive factor in combat strength.」

105:t_1:35.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I understand that, but whose words are those?」

105:t_1:37.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's fine, $$タクヤ$$. ...But differences in maintenance do decide combat strength... I'm counting on you to tune the $$リ・ガズィ$$.」

105:t_1:39.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're amazing, $$タクヤ$$. Captain $$アムロ$$ trusts you with his machine's maintenance.」

105:t_1:40.en:
$$ミコット$$
「$$タクヤ$$... works hard every day. He says, 'I'm a member of $c too.'」

105:t_1:41.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$タクヤ$$, $$ミコット$$, and I have been fighting ever since that battle at $$インダストリアル７$$...)

105:t_1:42.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$オードリー$$... What are you doing now...?)

105:t_1:44.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Are you thinking about your family?」

105:t_1:45.en:
$n
「No... I've already come to terms with what happened to Dad and Sis.」

105:t_1:46.en:
$n
「It's just... I lived in the former 《$$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$》 before coming to $$東京$$, so I'm concerned...」

105:t_1:47.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Now that you mention it, you did.」

105:t_1:48.en:
$n
「I lived deep in the $$ロッキー山脈$$, so what happened in society didn't affect me much.」

105:t_1:49.en:
$n
「But sometimes I think... If $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$ were here, North America might not have suffered this badly...」

105:t_1:50.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You mean the Emperor of $$ブリタニア$$...」

105:t_1:51.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「And he's $$ゼロ$$'s father too.」

105:t_1:52.en:
$n
「$$甲児$$ told me about $$ゼロ$$ and Emperor $$シャルル$$.」

105:t_1:53.en:
$n
「Whatever he was like as a person, even I could sense Emperor $$シャルル$$'s leadership and charisma.」

105:t_1:54.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「That's true. Those of us who actually fought him know that all too well.」

105:t_1:55.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'm also curious what measures Emperor $$シャルル$$ would have taken against these powerful invaders if he were alive.」

105:t_1:56.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「He was self-righteous, but he did want to make the world better in his own way.」

105:t_1:57.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「But his son never understood that.」

105:t_1:58.en:
$$マリー$$
「It's sad they couldn't understand each other despite being father and son... No, because they were father and son.」

105:t_1:59.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「In that respect... $$ＮＥＲＶ$$'s Commander $$碇$$ and $$シンジ$$ are alike too.」

105:t_1:60.en:
$$刹那$$
「But someone who can so easily discard others for his own goals cannot guide the world.」

105:t_1:63.en:
$n
「W-what is it, $$刹那$$? Are you trying to stop being the quiet type too...?」

105:t_1:64.en:
$$スズネ$$
($n... So you were bothered by it after all...)

105:t_1:68.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「This conversation's so sappy it makes me squirm just listening to it.」

105:t_1:69.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But I can really see it when I look at $$刹那$$ and $n now.」

105:t_1:70.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「That's true. They might stop being the quiet type soon too.」

105:t_1:71.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$ヒイロ$$, $$キリコ$$, and $$宗介$$ might be the same.」

105:t_1:72.en:
$$イアン$$
「Hey, $$ティエリア$$. You're conveniently forgetting about yourself.」

105:t_1:74.en:
$$イアン$$
「You've changed too. For the better, of course.」

105:t_1:76.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The environment around growing boys and girls is important, especially their friendships.」

105:t_1:77.en:
$n
「Ah... Please don't tell $$宗介$$, $$甲児$$, or the others about this.」

105:t_1:79.en:
$n
「Please give me a break, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

105:t_1:80.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Hee hee... Your embarrassment is boyish too. I like it.」

105:t_1:81.en:
$$マリー$$
「You're just like $n's mother, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

105:t_1:82.en:
$$スズネ$$
「At least call me his big sister!」
